overview: myScheme is a National Platform that aims to offer one-stop search and discovery of Government schemes from both Central and State/UT Governments. It provides an innovative, technology-based solution to discover scheme information based on citizen eligibility. The platform helps citizens find the right Government schemes for them and guides on how to apply, eliminating the need to visit multiple Government websites.
objectives: Offer one-stop search and discovery of Government schemes
Provide technology-based solution to discover scheme information based on eligibility
Help citizens find the right Government schemes for them
Guide on how to apply for different Government schemes
Eliminate the need to visit multiple Government websites
Streamline the government-user interface for government schemes and benefits
Reduce time and effort required to find and avail a government scheme
eligibility: Eligibility Check You can check your eligibility for schemes using different criteria and personal attribute
benefits: The myScheme platform provides comprehensive information on each scheme, including eligibility criteria, benefits offered, application procedure, and the documents required to avail the scheme. It also features a dedicated Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) section to address common queries related to the scheme.
application_process: 1. Enter Details: Start by entering your basic details! 2. Search: Our search engine will find the relevant schemes! 3. Select & Apply: Select and apply for the best suited scheme
implementing_agency: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), with the Support of Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievance (DARPG) and in partnership with other Central and State Ministries/Departments
